item.subject: science
item.stem:
Tara mixes a small spoonful of curd into a bowl of lukewarm milk and into a bowl of cold milk. She leaves both for a few hours. Only the lukewarm milk sets into curd. The cold milk may taste a little sour but does not set the same way.

Which statement best explains this difference?

options.A: Microorganisms in the curd starter grow and multiply faster in lukewarm milk, turning it into curd.
options.B: Lukewarm milk turns into curd immediately when the starter is mixed in.
options.C: Only the cold milk forms curd; lukewarm milk stays liquid because warmth stops the starter.
options.D: Both bowls have formed curd because both can taste a little sour.
